title: Not Going Into the Sea Caves

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager is invited to explore the dark sea caves and does not want to go: say no thank you, or decide at the entrance.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At low tide, some villagers are going to explore the sea caves at the end of the beach. They've done it before. It's fun, they say: dark, echoing, full of strange pools. (subject) has been invited. (subject.He/she) really doesn't want to go. Tight dark places full of water are not (subject.his/her) idea of fun. (friend) is waiting for an answer.

choices.label: Go to the Entrance and Decide There

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "No, thank you," says (subject). "But I'll keep watch on the tide." (friend) says that's actually very useful. The others go in. (subject) sits on a rock at the entrance and watches the water, and calls them out in good time. Everyone agrees it was the most sensible job of the day.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) walks with them to the cave mouth. (subject.He/she) looks in. Cold air breathes out of the dark. (subject.He/she) steps back. "This is as far as I go." Nobody argues. (subject.He/she) waits outside in the sun, and is very glad, when they come back out wet and muddy, that (subject.he/she) stayed dry.
